purpose: Relief of mild to moderate pain and fever reduction.
standard_dosage: 500mg to 1000mg every 4 to 6 hours as needed (Max 4000mg/day).
precautions: Avoid alcohol consumption while taking this medication.
Consult doctor if liver conditions exist.

purpose: Treatment of bacterial infections such as pneumonia, bronchitis, and ear infections.
standard_dosage: 250mg to 500mg every 8 hours or as prescribed by a physician.
precautions: Do not use if allergic to Penicillin or cephalosporins.
Complete the full prescribed course even if symptoms improve.

purpose: Relief of bronchospasm in respiratory conditions like Asthma and COPD.
standard_dosage: 1 to 2 inhalations every 4 to 6 hours as needed for shortness of breath.
precautions: Use as directed. Excessive use can cause cardiovascular stimulation.
Inform doctor if shortness of breath worsens rapidly.
